opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Maximum £20,000 (New Projects and Commissions; Acquisitions and Collections; Long-Term Research grants); £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures and Publications); £2,500 (Research and Travel grants)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (must have been operating non-profit for at least 12 months) for New Projects/Commissions, Acquisitions/Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications and Long-Term Research; individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for Research and Travel grants. Not open to individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding the appreciation of sculpture. Categories cover exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display. Applications are considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000; accommodation provided in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and established scholars working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Institute/Studios & Gardens), artists developing practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships), and established scholars for longer Senior Fellowships. Studios & Gardens fellowships only for projects related to Henry Moore.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using research facilities at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications closed for 2026/27 and the next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes awarded for outstanding writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. Submissions for the next prize open in autumn.
